chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us, saying: Al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban narrated to us, from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Ali ibn 'Uqba, from Abu Khalid al-Qammat, from Hamran, who said:

I said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): The saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: 'Whoever kills a soul unless for a soul or for corruption [done] in the earth - it is as if he had slain mankind entirely.' And indeed, he only killed one person?

He said: He will be placed in a spot in Hell to which extends the utmost severity of the torment of its people. If he were to kill all people, he would only enter that place. And if he had killed one person, he would only enter that place. I said: And if he kills another? He said: It shall be doubled upon him.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'killing one person is like killing all mankind' in Shia interpretation?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates the hyperbolic nature of the verse by explaining that the severity of the punishment for a single murder is so immense that it fills the entirety of Hell's domain, making the act of killing one person equivalent to killing all mankind in terms of penal magnitude. He further clarifies that this is not a literal equivalence of souls but a qualitative intensification of divine retribution, where subsequent murders result in an exponential doubling of the punishment. This interpretation highlights the unique weight of bloodshed in Shia jurisprudence and theology, distinguishing it from other sins.

en.basel-kadem: 2.	We were told by Muhammed bin Hasan, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Hussain bin Hasan bin Aban, from Hussain bin Sa’eed, from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr, from Ali bin ‘Uqba, from Abu Khalid al-Qammat, from Hamran, that he said:

I said to Abu Ja’far, peace be upon him. The saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «Due to that, We prescribed upon the sons of Isra’eel that whoever kills a life without (retaliation for) another life, or due to (the causing of) corruption on earth, it is as if he has killed all people» [5:32] whereas one only kills one?

He said: He will placed in a spot of Hell to which ends the utmost severity of the torment of its people if one was to kill all people. He will then only enter that place. If he had killed one, he would only enter that place. I said: And if he kills another? He said: It shall be doubled upon him.
